runs.summary: T-460 is in review: the prompt packs v2 checks pass locally and on the live Worker. The Day 1 to 3 delivery campaigns still can't be created until Tantra has a sender mailbox, which waits on T-408. I changed no code in this run, so there was nothing to commit.
T-460 is back in review. The prompt packs v2 probe passes locally and on the live centre, but the day delivery campaigns are still blocked on T-408, and v2 still isn't merged into main.

decisions.decision: Build v2 on top of T-427's existing prompt card and GET /api/prompts/day/:n. Each day's pack opens with a 'Save today's context' prompt that writes context/business.md and that day's answers. Next comes one prompt per card that has build work. Each one names tasks/<code>-<id>.md, carries the attendee's answers for that card, lists the outputs/ files it must write, and ends with a self-check. The pack closes with the day's wrap prompt. Human-only cards get no prompt. Add a plain-text endpoint, GET /api/prompts/day/:n.txt. The chat edition must also work without tools. Day email and WhatsApp copy already carry {{custom.dayN_prompts_link}}. Point it at the pack, then recreate the Tantra delivery campaigns we own so they use the new template. Extend probe-day-prompts.mjs to v2 assertions and run it locally and live. Feed the packs to T-461/T-462. Move the task to review with ?v= links.
decisions.why: Plan REVOPS_OS_PLAN_2026_10_15 rows 3 and T-460 spell out this spec. T-427 already shipped the v1 card, the endpoint and the email/WhatsApp link, so v2 extends it. Our own Worker and campaigns are agent work under Adi's 2026-10-12 rule.

decisions.decision: The v2 code is already in the repo. prompt-pack.ts builds the 'Save today's context' prompt, the per-card prompts that end in a self-check, and the wrap. cloud/src/index.ts serves /api/prompts/day/:n and its .txt twin, and /enter?pack=N redirects to the pack. probe-day-prompts.mjs has the v2 assertions. To finish: (1) Run probe-day-prompts.mjs locally for days 0-3 and fix anything that fails. (2) Deploy the revops-centre Worker, then run the probe against the live origin, including the '(v2 deployed)' self-check assertion and the /enter?pack redirect. (3) Point {{custom.dayN_prompts_link}} at /enter?pack=N and recreate our own Tantra day delivery campaigns with that template. (4) Commit and push. (5) Give the live packs to T-461/T-462. (6) Log the probe output, move T-460 to review with ?v= links, and set the board status to doing in the meantime.
decisions.why: I checked the repo: prompt-pack.ts, the Worker routes and the v2 probe already exist, so what's left is verifying, deploying and the campaigns. The 2026-10-18 proceed decision already approved those steps. Under Adi's 2026-10-12 rule, our own Worker and campaigns are agent work.
